notes.title: New Price ($5.99) and Bug Fixes for Languages
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're excited to tell you we have dropped our price to around six dollars in time for the holidays.

We have also fixed some pesky language bugs for Polish, Russian, and Ukrainian. We hope that the game can now be fully enjoyed in those languages!

- Ben, your friendly neighborhood Game Designer

notes.title: Welcome Back
notes.notes:
Hi!

Ben Roye, Game Designer, here. We are super excited to bring you Kraven Manor for the first time on Steam. We have taken the time to add some of the things you would expect from a Steam game, like achievements and cloud saves. We also annihilated some bugs and added some languages in the process.

From students to a professional studio, we have had a blast creating and optimizing this game for your Steam experience. We sincerely hope you have as much fun playing it as we did bringing it to you.

The doors of Kraven's manor await. Can you still your trembling hands long enough to get the secret ending?

- Ben and the Demon Wagon Studios team

notes.title: Best Gameplay and Best Visual Quality Awards at Game Developers Conference
notes.notes:
At Game Developers Conference in March 2014, Intel sponsored a game exhibition which showcased student games made around the country. Intel only gave out two awards at the show. The Kraven Manor team was humbled by some of the great showings at the event. In the end, Kraven Manor received both the Best Gameplay and Best Visual Quality awards from Intel.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296630/discussions] You can click here to visit our Steam forums to see more articles and videos about the game.	[/url]
